name: DFW Winter Variation 2024

venue.name: [University of North Texas Union](https://studentaffairs.unt.edu/university-union)
venue.details: Saturday: Emerald Ballroom (314BC), Sunday: Meeting Room 382

information:
#### Please review the [Schedule tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWWinterVariation2024#competition-schedule) prior to registering. Many competitors will only have events on Saturday, as Sunday takes place in a smaller room featuring blindfolded events, big cubes, and some final rounds.

This competition is supported by [CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org/).

- Please review the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWWinterVariation2024#35647-competitor-information) tab before the competition.
- Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition.
	
To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/).
